answer: Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Rushbound straw weigher pitch bond sees to it, since a bond straw weighers lodge after thatch office checks. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. A farm faces a fare of £26 for the journey to the registry, paid per name for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. One willow, one entry. harbor is written on the receipt. The tally keeps mesa.
